texts.zh:
我们对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领导层的渗透并不像我们被灌输的那样彻底。在起先渗透主要国家失败后，我们尝试在一些较小的政权中发动政变。即便如此我们也还是未能获得民众的支持。

我们已经从[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]撤回了所有还健在的特工。当地居民显然会在未来几年内保持警惕。
texts.en:
Our infiltration of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership was not as complete as we had been led to believe. After initially failing to infiltrate their major nations, we attempted a coup within a minor power. Yet even there, the people didn't want us.

We have extracted all our surviving operatives from [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants are sure to be on alert for years to come.
